summary: Taxonomy and occurrence context for Parahippus is open in PBDB (74 occurrences), and a CC0 Dryad dataset provides 3D skull morphometrics plus a species-level Equidae phylogeny, but it was not possible to confirm that Parahippus is among its specimens. MorphoSource lists six Parahippus specimens with no public scans, and no equid-specific MorphoBank matrix was found, so no single open source combines skull geometry and an independent character-based placement of Parahippus.
next_step: Obtain the Dryad zip (285 MB, needs a Dryad token or browser download) and list its specimens; if Parahippus is absent, compile a cladistic matrix from the primary equid literature.
obstacles_confirmed: MorphoSource has no media for Parahippus.
MorphoBank portal returned 403 to scripted requests, so matrices could not be inspected.
Dryad file downloads require an authentication token (HTTP 401).
